title: Low Carb Dutch Doner Meat Kebabs
description: A malty, cheese-pull, quick-fix Dutch dish featuring doner meat with an al-dente finish, low in glycemic index.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together malt flour, almond flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced doner meat to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and set aside.
Thread the coated doner meat onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through.
While the skewers are baking, melt the grated cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with the melted cheese.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
